title: Fix the Match Counter
instructions:
This function is supposed to print "Match 1" through "Match 5" for a 5-match event. But it is printing "Match 0" through "Match 5" instead -- that is 6 lines and there is no Match 0!

Fix the range so it prints the correct match numbers: 1 through `matchCount`.
hint: Look at where the range starts. `0..matchCount` starts at 0, but matches start at 1. Change the range to start at 1.
